items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: My second brother was a saxophone player at the time, and we had a little trio.

ctx.x: I was wondering about some of the early bands that you played with, some of the very first bands that you mentioned.

Well, the first one that I remember was a little group that we had. My second brother was a saxophone player at the time, and we had a little trio. We had a, I played the drum at the time, my brother played the saxophone, and we had a boy with a banjo. He later went over the piano and we got another boy on the banjo. And we used to play for all the little functions in those days, like weddings, king parties, birthday parties. And it was customary then to have those parties in the homes, in the private residences.…
About how old were you when you got paid for your first job? Do you remember?
